title: Readiness status reads conditions in one batch, probe targets run four at a time
includePaid from a non-SystemAdmin is rejected
detail: `readiness:write:run-probes` ignored the role of the caller for `includePaid`, so any TenantAdmin could trigger paid probes. A TenantAdmin that sends `includePaid: true` now gets `access_denied` and no run is started. `readiness:query:latest-summary` reports `hasPaidProbes` as false for everyone but a SystemAdmin, so the paid action on the system check screen is only offered to a SystemAdmin.
migration: Send `includePaid: true` only from a SystemAdmin session. Apps with their own button for the paid run must show it to a SystemAdmin only; a TenantAdmin request with `includePaid` now fails instead of running the free probes.

title: Readiness probes judge running runs by startedAt
system check runs are rate limited per user
System-check history keeps runs of the same second in order
The paid run is a button next to Start check
The paid probe hint names the button
The search probe fails with its own text
An empty latest run says why it is empty
Probe runs and the system-check screen
migration: New table read_readiness_probe_runs. Apps that mount readiness run `kumiko schema generate` and apply the migration before deploying. Without a nav option the screen stays dormant; pass createReadinessFeature({ nav: {} }) or a parent nav QN to show it.

title: The deprecated readinessFeature constant is removed
detail: readinessFeature was kept next to createReadinessFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createReadinessFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces readinessFeature with createReadinessFeature().
